pages.text: Two or more, with a plan, in the Nether and the deep.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Radiation Director$() and the $(bold)Leviathan$(): $(bold)Precision mechanisms$(), mechanical arms and the reactor's own parts.$(li)$(bold)Netherite Monstrosity$() and the $(bold)Ancient Remnant$(): $(bold)Netherite$().$(li)$(bold)Maledictus$(): $(bold)Cannons$() (Big Cannons).

Maledictus and the Remnant also drop the $(bold)Ancient Factory's$() Eye.$(br2)Cannons are a server rule as much as a technology: they damage $(bold)mobs and players$() but not the land. Griefing is off; sieges are on.
